newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB vulnerable to foreign takeover-Argus.
newsitem.headline: NAB vulnerable to foreign takeover-Argus.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd managing director Don Argus said on Thursday he felt the bank was vulnerable to foreign takeover.

"I do, I certainly do, particularly when some of our friendly merchant banks from the Northern Hemisphere tell you that you're at the top of the Hit Parade," he told reporters when asked about the possibility of a foreign takeover offer.
When asked if NAB's share price had been underpinned by takeover speculation, he said: "Probably but I'd like to think that the market has finally realised that this isn't a bad organisation."
